test_qr_register: test the qr_register function that performs a full Feishu QR-based device registration flow
test_init_registration: test _init_registration to verify it checks for client_secret support and raises on failure
test_begin_registration: test _begin_registration to verify it returns device_code, qr_url, and user_code from the Feishu API
test_poll_registration: test _poll_registration to verify it polls until credentials are returned or timeout occurs
test_probe_bot: test probe_bot to verify it returns bot info via SDK or falls back to raw HTTP when SDK is unavailable
